verdict.rationale: Elicit documents concrete open-format exports: Library as .ris (importable to Zotero/Mendeley/EndNote), tables as CSV/Excel/RIS/BIB, and reports as PDF/DOCX, plus programmatic access via API/MCP. However, some exports (screening/extraction tables) are gated to Pro/Scale/Enterprise plans, and there's no documentation of a full account-level 'export everything and delete/leave' capability covering projects, skills, or chat history. missing for 10: full account-data export/deletion workflow, confirmation that all exports are unrestricted across plans, independent verification of export completeness.
